name: Apple & cinnamon porridge
ingredients: 1½ cups rolled oats|2½ cups full cream milk|1 apple, grated (skin on)|½ tsp cinnamon (pantry)|Greek yoghurt to top
method: Put oats, milk and grated apple in a saucepan over medium heat.|Stir for 5–6 minutes until thick and the apple is soft.|Stir in the cinnamon.|Spoon into bowls and top with yoghurt.|Cool Dexter's bowl with a splash of cold milk.
dexter: Thin with extra milk and check the temperature — porridge holds heat. The apple sweetens it, so no honey or sugar.

name: Cheesy scrambled eggs on toast
ingredients: 4 eggs|¼ cup milk|⅓ cup grated tasty cheese|Small knob of butter|4 slices wholemeal bread|Handful baby spinach (optional)
method: Whisk eggs and milk in a bowl.|Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low–medium heat.|Add eggs and gently push around until just set.|Stir through cheese and chopped spinach off the heat.|Serve on buttered toast.
dexter: Cook Dexter's eggs until fully set, with no runny bits. Cut toast into fingers.

name: Pikelets with yoghurt & apple
ingredients: 1 cup plain flour (pantry)|2 tsp baking powder (pantry)|2 eggs|¾ cup milk|Butter for the pan|1 apple, finely sliced|Greek yoghurt to serve
method: Whisk flour, baking powder, eggs and milk into a smooth, thick batter.|Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.|Drop tablespoons of batter in; cook until bubbles appear, then flip, about 1 minute each side.|Serve stacked with yoghurt and apple slices.
dexter: Make a few tiny ones for Dexter to hold. Serve apple very thinly sliced or grated so it's easy to chew.

name: Smashed avo & egg toast
ingredients: 2 avocados|4 eggs|5 slices wholemeal bread|Squeeze of lemon or pinch of pepper (optional)
method: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.|Mash avocado with a fork.|Toast the bread and spread thickly with avocado.|Slice or mash the eggs on top.
dexter: Mash Dexter's egg into his avocado and spread it on toast fingers. Avocado is a great first food.

name: Leftovers from last night
ingredients: Leftovers from the night before
method: Reheat until steaming hot all the way through, stirring halfway.|Top with a little grated cheese or a spoon of yoghurt if you like.
dexter: Cut or mash Dexter's portion into small pieces and check it isn't too hot.
pack: Spoon a portion into a microwave-safe container the night before and keep it in the fridge. At work, reheat 2–3 minutes, stirring halfway, until piping hot.

name: Cheese & spinach toasties
ingredients: 5 slices wholemeal bread|1 cup grated tasty cheese|Handful baby spinach|Butter|Cucumber sticks to serve
method: Butter the outside of each slice of bread.|Fill with cheese and a few spinach leaves.|Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes each side until golden.|Slice and serve with cucumber sticks.
dexter: Let it cool, because melted cheese stays hot. Cut into small squares and peel the cucumber.

name: Veggie egg fried rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice (cold is best)|3 eggs|1 cup frozen peas & corn|1 carrot, grated|1 tsp minced garlic|1 tbsp stir-fry sauce|1 tbsp oil (pantry)
method: Heat oil in a large pan or wok over high heat.|Scramble the eggs, then push to one side.|Add garlic, carrot and peas & corn; cook 3 minutes.|Add the rice and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until hot.|Scoop Dexter's portion out, then stir the sauce through the rest.
dexter: Serve Dexter's portion before the sauce goes in, because stir-fry sauce is salty.
pack: Cool quickly and pack in a microwave-safe container. Keep it in the work fridge, then reheat until steaming hot all the way through.

name: Cheesy corn & capsicum quesadillas
ingredients: 3 tortilla wraps|1 cup grated tasty cheese|½ capsicum, finely diced|½ cup frozen corn (from peas & corn)|Handful baby spinach, chopped|Yoghurt to dip
method: Scatter cheese, capsicum, corn and spinach over half of each wrap, then fold over.|Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes each side until golden and melted.|Cut into wedges and serve with yoghurt to dip.
dexter: Cut into thin strips Dexter can hold.
pack: Cook the night before, cool, and wrap the wedges in foil. They're good cold or warmed for 30 seconds. Pack the yoghurt dip in a small pot.

name: Egg & spinach sandwiches
ingredients: 6 eggs|6 slices wholemeal bread|Butter|Handful baby spinach|Cucumber slices
method: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.|Mash with a fork and a little butter.|Spread on bread with spinach and cucumber, then top with another slice.|Cut into triangles.
dexter: Mash Dexter's egg extra smooth and serve as small soft squares, with crusts off if he prefers.
pack: Make in the morning and keep cold with an ice brick. Pack the cucumber separately so the bread doesn't go soggy.

name: Chicken, cheese & salad wraps
ingredients: 250 g chicken breast|3 tortilla wraps|½ cup grated tasty cheese|Handful baby spinach|1 cucumber, sliced|½ capsicum, sliced|2 tbsp Greek yoghurt + pinch of paprika (pantry) as dressing
method: Pan-fry or poach the chicken until cooked through (about 10 minutes), cool and slice thinly.|Mix the yoghurt with a pinch of paprika for the dressing.|Lay out the wraps and spread with dressing.|Add chicken, cheese, spinach, cucumber and capsicum.|Roll up tightly and cut in half.
dexter: Give Dexter shredded chicken, cheese and soft wrap strips with peeled cucumber.
pack: Cook the chicken the night before. Roll the wraps in the morning, wrap them in baking paper, and keep cold with an ice brick.

name: Creamy chicken pasta salad
ingredients: 250 g penne|250 g chicken breast|1 cup frozen peas & corn|½ capsicum, diced|Handful baby spinach, shredded|½ cup Greek yoghurt + 1 tsp minced garlic|¼ cup grated cheese
method: Cook the penne, adding the peas & corn for the last 2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.|Poach the chicken 10–12 minutes until cooked, then cool and dice.|Mix the yoghurt and garlic into a dressing.|Toss everything together with the capsicum, spinach and cheese.|Divide into containers. It keeps 3 days in the fridge.
dexter: Chop Dexter's pasta and chicken small. The yoghurt dressing is mild and creamy.
pack: Make a batch on Sunday night. Pack straight from the fridge with an ice brick and eat it cold, no microwave needed.

name: Mini frittata muffins & salad
ingredients: 8 eggs|¼ cup milk|½ cup grated tasty cheese|Handful baby spinach, chopped|½ capsicum, diced|½ cup frozen peas & corn|1 cucumber, cut into sticks
method: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 12-hole muffin tin.|Whisk the eggs and milk; stir in the cheese and veg.|Pour into the tin, about ¾ full.|Bake 18–20 minutes until set and golden.|Cool on a rack and serve with cucumber sticks.
dexter: Perfect finger food for Dexter. Cut one into quarters and make sure the centre is fully set.
pack: Bake a batch on the weekend. They keep 3 days in the fridge and are tasty cold, so pack 3 each with cucumber sticks and an ice brick.

name: Burrito rice bowls
ingredients: 1½ cups cooked rice|420 g tin kidney beans, drained|1 cup frozen peas & corn|½ capsicum, diced|1 tsp ground cumin (pantry)|½ cup grated cheese|Greek yoghurt to top
method: Warm the beans, peas & corn and capsicum in a pan with the cumin for 5 minutes.|Divide the rice between containers.|Top with the bean mix and cheese.|Add a spoon of yoghurt on top, or pack it separately.
dexter: Mash Dexter's beans a little and mix them through rice with cheese.
pack: Pack in a microwave-safe container with the yoghurt in a separate pot. Reheat the bowl for 2 minutes, then add the yoghurt.

name: Hidden-veg spaghetti bolognese
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|1 onion, finely diced|1 carrot, grated|1 capsicum, finely diced|Handful baby spinach, chopped|2 tsp minced garlic|2 × 400 g tins diced tomatoes|2 tbsp tomato paste|1 tsp dried Italian herbs (pantry)|500 g spaghetti|Grated cheese to serve
method: Brown the mince in a large pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up; set aside.|Soften onion, carrot and capsicum in the same pan, 5 minutes.|Add garlic and tomato paste; stir 1 minute.|Return the mince; add tomatoes and herbs. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring the spinach through at the end.|Meanwhile cook spaghetti per the packet.|Serve with cheese. Keep a portion for tomorrow's lunch.
dexter: No added salt, so season adult plates at the table. Snip Dexter's spaghetti short.

name: Chicken & veg stir-fry with rice
ingredients: 550 g chicken breast, thinly sliced|1 capsicum, sliced|1 carrot, thinly sliced|2 cups frozen mixed vegetables|2 tsp minced garlic|3 tbsp stir-fry sauce|2 cups rice (makes extra for fried rice)|1 tbsp oil (pantry)
method: Cook the rice: 2 cups rice to 3 cups water, covered, 12–15 minutes, then rest 5.|Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken 5–6 minutes until cooked; set aside.|Stir-fry carrot, capsicum and frozen veg for 4 minutes.|Return the chicken with the garlic and toss for 1 minute.|Take out Dexter's portion, then add the sauce and toss.|Serve over rice. Chill the leftover rice quickly.
dexter: Take Dexter's portion out before the sauce. Cut his chicken into small pieces.

name: Sausage & veggie tray bake
ingredients: 500 g thin sausages|900 g potatoes, cut in chunks|3 carrots, chunked|1 onion, cut in wedges|1 tbsp oil + dried herbs (pantry)|Steamed frozen veg to serve
method: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan-forced).|Toss potato, carrot and onion with oil and herbs on a lined tray.|Roast 15 minutes, then add the sausages.|Roast another 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are cooked and the veg is golden.|Serve with steamed veg.
dexter: Choking risk: peel the sausage skin, then cut lengthways and into small pieces for Dexter. Mash soft veg if needed.

name: Mild chicken, potato & carrot curry
ingredients: 550 g chicken thigh fillets, diced|1 onion, diced|2 potatoes, small cubes|1 carrot, sliced|1–2 tbsp mild curry paste|400 ml coconut milk|2 handfuls baby spinach|1 cup frozen peas & corn|1½ cups rice|Yoghurt to serve
method: Cook the rice.|Soften the onion in a little oil, 4 minutes.|Add the curry paste (start with 1 tbsp) and stir for 1 minute.|Add chicken, potato and carrot; stir to coat.|Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 15–20 minutes until the potato is tender.|Stir through spinach and peas & corn for the last 3 minutes.|Serve with rice and yoghurt. Save a portion for tomorrow's lunch.
dexter: Use 1 tbsp of paste so it stays mild, and stir yoghurt through Dexter's bowl to cool it.

name: Red chicken pasta bake
ingredients: 500 g penne|500 g chicken breast|2 × 500 g jars tomato pasta bake sauce
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12–15 minutes until cooked through.|Shred the chicken with two forks.|Cook the penne 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.|Mix the pasta, shredded chicken and pasta bake sauce in a baking dish.|Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.
dexter: Jar sauces are a bit salty, so give Dexter a smaller portion with extra plain pasta and some steamed veg on the side.

name: Beef taco wraps
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|1 onion, diced|1 tsp minced garlic|1 tsp each ground cumin & sweet paprika (pantry)|2 × 400 g tins diced tomatoes|5 tortilla wraps|1 capsicum, diced|2 cucumbers, diced|Grated cheese|Greek yoghurt (instead of sour cream)
method: Brown the mince with the onion over medium-high heat, 6–7 minutes.|Add garlic, cumin and paprika; stir 1 minute.|Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick.|Warm the wraps in a dry pan or microwave.|Set everything out and let everyone build their own.
dexter: No chilli and no seasoning packet, which is very salty. Give Dexter a plate of mince, cheese and soft veg.

name: Veggie frittata with potato wedges
ingredients: 6 eggs|½ cup milk|½ capsicum, diced|2 handfuls baby spinach|½ cup frozen peas|½ cup grated cheese|500 g potatoes, cut in wedges|1 tbsp oil (pantry)|Cucumber to serve
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the wedges in oil and roast 30–35 minutes.|Whisk the eggs and milk.|Soften the capsicum in an oven-proof pan for 4 minutes; add spinach and peas.|Pour over the eggs, sprinkle with cheese and cook on low heat 5 minutes until the edges set.|Finish in the oven 10–12 minutes until fully set and golden.|Slice and serve with the wedges.
dexter: Make sure the centre is fully set. Cut into fingers for Dexter.

name: Baked salmon, creamy mash & greens
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets|800 g potatoes, peeled and chunked|Knob of butter + splash of milk|2 cups frozen mixed vegetables|Lemon or dill (optional)
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft.|Put the salmon on a lined tray and bake 12–14 minutes.|Steam the frozen veg.|Mash the potatoes with butter and milk.|Serve salmon on mash with the veg.
dexter: Flake Dexter's salmon and check carefully for bones. Salmon is brilliant for growing brains.

name: Mini beef meatballs & spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|1 egg|1 slice bread, made into crumbs|1 small onion, grated|1 carrot, grated|2 tsp minced garlic|2 × 400 g tins diced tomatoes|500 g spaghetti|Grated cheese
method: Mix mince, egg, breadcrumbs, half the onion and the carrot; roll into small balls.|Brown the meatballs in a little oil, 5 minutes; set aside.|Soften the rest of the onion with the garlic, then add the tomatoes.|Return the meatballs and simmer 15 minutes.|Cook spaghetti and serve with cheese.
dexter: Squash Dexter's meatballs and cut into small pieces. Snip his spaghetti short.

name: Tandoori yoghurt drumsticks, crispy potatoes & raita
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks|1 cup Greek yoghurt + extra for the raita|2 tbsp mild curry paste|2 tsp minced garlic|1 tsp each smoked paprika & ground cumin (pantry)|700 g potatoes, cubed|2 cups frozen mixed vegetables|1 cucumber, grated
method: Mix ¾ cup yoghurt with the curry paste, garlic, paprika and cumin.|Slash each drumstick twice and coat in the marinade (marinate 30 minutes, or overnight if you can).|Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes in oil and roast on one tray; put the drumsticks on another.|Roast 40–45 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is charred at the edges and cooked through.|Roast the frozen veg for the last 15 minutes.|Stir the grated cucumber into the rest of the yoghurt for the raita and serve on the side.
dexter: Mild and tangy, with no chilli. Pull Dexter's chicken off the bone, shred it and add a spoon of raita.

name: Shepherd's pie
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|1 onion, diced|2 carrots, diced|1 cup frozen peas & corn|2 tbsp tomato paste|900 g potatoes|Butter + splash of milk|Grated cheese
method: Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with butter and milk.|Brown the mince with onion and carrot, 8 minutes.|Stir in the tomato paste, peas & corn and ½ cup water; simmer 10 minutes.|Spoon into a baking dish, top with mash and cheese.|Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
dexter: Lovely soft texture for Dexter. Let it cool a little before serving.

name: Creamy chicken & spinach pasta
ingredients: 550 g chicken breast, diced small|500 g penne|1 small onion, diced|2 tsp minced garlic|2 big handfuls baby spinach|1½ cups milk|1 tbsp plain flour (pantry)|Knob of butter|½ cup grated tasty cheese
method: Cook the penne per the packet; save a cup of the pasta water.|Brown the chicken in a little butter, 6–7 minutes, then set aside.|Soften the onion and garlic, 3 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.|Whisk in the milk and simmer until it thickens, about 3 minutes.|Stir in the cheese, spinach, chicken and pasta, loosening with pasta water if needed.
dexter: Creamy and mild, so Dexter can have it straight from the pot. Cut his chicken small and his pasta in half.

name: Mild beef & bean burrito bowls
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|420 g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed|2 × 400 g tins diced tomatoes|1 onion, diced|1 capsicum, diced|1 tsp minced garlic|1 tsp each ground cumin & sweet paprika (pantry)|1½ cups rice|Grated cheese, yoghurt and 1 avocado to top
method: Cook the rice.|Brown the mince with onion and capsicum, 7 minutes.|Add garlic and spices, then the beans and tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.|Mash the avocado.|Build bowls of rice, beef and beans, cheese, yoghurt and avocado.
dexter: No chilli at all. Mash Dexter's beans a little and top his bowl with avocado and yoghurt.

name: Chilli con carne
ingredients: 500 g beef mince|420 g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed|2 × 400 g tins diced tomatoes|2 tbsp tomato paste|1 onion, diced|1 capsicum, diced|2 tsp minced garlic|2 tsp ground cumin + 2 tsp sweet paprika (pantry)|Chilli flakes for the adults (pantry)|1½ cups rice|Grated cheese and yoghurt to serve
method: Cook the rice.|Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum, 7 minutes.|Add garlic, cumin and paprika; stir 1 minute.|Add tomato paste, tomatoes and beans; simmer 20 minutes until thick.|Scoop out Dexter's portion, then stir chilli flakes into the rest to taste.|Serve over rice with cheese and a spoon of yoghurt.
dexter: Dexter's bowl comes out before any chilli goes in. Mash his beans a little and cool it with yoghurt.

name: Dumplings & rice with broccolini
ingredients: 750 g bag frozen chicken dumplings|1½ cups rice|2 bunches broccolini (or a head of broccoli)|1 tsp minced garlic|1 tbsp stir-fry sauce for the adults|1 tbsp oil (pantry)
method: Cook the rice.|Pan-fry the dumplings in a little oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, then add ½ cup water, cover and steam 6–8 minutes.|Steam or stir-fry the broccolini with the garlic for 3–4 minutes.|Serve dumplings and broccolini over rice, with a little stir-fry sauce for the grown-ups.
dexter: Cut Dexter's dumplings into quarters and check the filling has cooled. Serve his broccolini soft and in small pieces, with no sauce.

name: Mild butter chicken with rice
ingredients: 550 g chicken breast, diced|1 onion, finely diced|2 tsp minced garlic|1 tbsp mild curry paste|2 tbsp tomato paste|400 g tin diced tomatoes|30 g butter|½ cup Greek yoghurt + ½ cup milk|2 handfuls baby spinach|1½ cups rice
method: Cook the rice.|Melt the butter and soften the onion and garlic, 4 minutes.|Stir in the curry paste and tomato paste for 1 minute.|Add the chicken and brown lightly, then the tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes.|Take off the heat and stir through the yoghurt, milk and spinach.|Serve over rice. Save a portion for tomorrow's lunch.
dexter: Creamy and mild, so Dexter can share it. Shred his chicken finely.

name: Chicken fajita wraps
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast, sliced into strips|2 capsicums, sliced|1 onion, sliced|1 tsp each ground cumin & sweet paprika (pantry)|6 tortilla wraps|Grated cheese and Greek yoghurt|Cucumber, diced
method: Toss the chicken with the spices and a little oil.|Cook the chicken in a hot pan for 6–7 minutes until cooked through; set aside.|Cook the capsicum and onion 5 minutes until soft and a little charred.|Warm the wraps.|Fill with chicken, veg, cheese, yoghurt and cucumber.
dexter: Shred Dexter's chicken and serve it with soft capsicum, cucumber and wrap strips he can hold.

name: Crumbed chicken strips, wedges & peas
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast, cut into strips|2 eggs, beaten|3 slices bread, made into crumbs|¼ cup plain flour (pantry)|700 g potatoes, cut into wedges|2 cups frozen peas & corn|Yoghurt to dip|Oil (pantry)
method: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the wedges in oil and roast 35–40 minutes.|Dust the chicken in flour, dip in egg, then press into the breadcrumbs.|Bake the strips on a lined tray for 18–20 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.|Cook the peas & corn.|Serve with yoghurt to dip.
dexter: Homemade nuggets for Dexter! Cut the strips into finger-sized pieces and let them cool.

name: Snacks & Dexter's milk
ingredients: Bananas|Apples|Yoghurt|Cheese|Cucumber sticks|Milk for Dexter
method: Grab-and-go snacks for the week.
dexter: Bananas are Dexter's snack favourite.
